Proposal B — pergola roof & structure plan
N beam: integrated gutter, falls to corner posts

Blades closed = watertight roof (rain drains along blades into N & S gutter beams, then down all 4 posts). Open 90° = full ventilation; 135° = evening sun-shading. Snow: blades auto-open when snow load sensor triggers (supplier option) or stay closed if designed for site snow. All dimensions to be confirmed by supplier's shop drawings.
